description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “The Tranquil Turtle”, a newly renovated and beautifully refreshed beach cottage in the sought-after gated community of Watersound West Beach. Designed for comfort and style, this charming home offers 3 King Suites, a Queen Flex Room with a built-in workspace, a 6-person LSV, and 4 beach cruisers. With access to the zero-entry community pool and a scenic boardwalk leading to Deer Lake’s secluded white-sand beaches, it’s the perfect retreat for families or groups seeking a peaceful, elevated 30A escape.*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Newly Renovated — Custom brick fireplace, upgraded lighting and furniture, and refined coastal interiors throughout3 Private King Suites — Spacious rooms with private bathrooms for restful, luxurious staysQueen Flex Room — A cozy bonus room with a queen bed and dedicated office area—ideal for extra guests or remote work6-Seater LSV — Zip to the beach, local dining, and shops in minutes4 Adult Beach Cruisers — Ride along 30A's scenic trails to explore with easeDeer Lake Beach Access — Private community boardwalk leads to a hidden stretch of sugar-white shorelineScreened-In Porch — Relax in the shade with your morning coffee or an evening cocktailAccess to Community Pool — Zero-entry resort-style pool just a short stroll away for easy, refreshing dipsEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ “Property is exactly as listed, impeccably maintained, the grounds and neighborhood was beautiful, the pool perfect, and the boardwalk walk to the beach was a favorite for everyone. We went in the off season and basically had the entire place to ourselves. The golf cart was perfect to get us to local hangout spots, etc.” – Jordan P.⭐ “Adorable clean home, loved the decor. The hall bunks and extra queen room. Bikes were a great addition as was the golf cart and beach cart.” – Jennifer B.⭐ “We really enjoyed the neighborhood and the amenities of the house. The house itself was nice and the perfect size for our party.!” –Taylor C.*** LIVING AREAS ***Enjoy light-filled, open-concept living with brand-new furnishings and tasteful coastal touches. The highlight? A custom brick fireplace with a locally crafted mantel—adding warmth and charm to every stay.Comfortable seating with all-new furniture and décorSmart TV for movie nights or rainy days indoorsCustom brick fireplace for cozy ambianceScreened-in porch with plush seating for tranquil outdoor lounging*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The well-appointed kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, a large island, and everything you need for mealtime. New custom cabinetry in the dining area adds extra functionality.Stainless steel appliances and generous prep spaceDining table with seating for 6Breakfast bar with seating for 4Custom cabinetry for serving, storage, and style*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, En-suite with walk-in shower and dual vanitiesHalf Bath: Conveniently located for guest use2nd FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, En-suite bath with walk-in shower and dual vanitiesKing Guest Suite: King bed, shared bathroom with shower/tub comboQueen Flex Room: Queen bed and office space with pocket door for privacy—ideal for extra guests or remote workHall Bunk: Twin-over-Queen bunk for kids or additional guests*** OUTDOOR SPACES & AMENITIES ***Screened-in back porch with cushioned seating and wooded viewsOutdoor shower for rinsing off post-beachAccess to Watersound West Beach’s zero-entry community poolA short walk or a quick bike or LSV ride to the private beach boardwalk via Deer Lake*** NEARBY ATTRACTIONS ***Set within the gated Watersound West Beach, you’ll enjoy peaceful boardwalks, lush nature paths, and private access to the Gulf. This location blends coastal charm with convenience.The Big Chill – Family-friendly entertainment with food trucks, games, and outdoor movies – 2 miles awaySeagrove Beach – Relax on sugar-white sands and enjoy boutique shopping and dining – 4 miles awaySeaside – Iconic town with cobblestone streets, artsy shops, and vibrant restaurants – 5 miles awayAlys Beach – Upscale destination with gourmet dining and signature architecture – 6 miles away*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.Waiver required to gain access to the 6-seater LSV.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 20714STRO #: STR-020714

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
